name: Fallen
journal: I died, and woke falling out of the sky. Men with nets were waiting.

steps.text: Find a way out of the cage.
Take Nell to the bakery in Hearthmere, west along the road. Elda bakes before dawn.
Find the Adventurers Guild at the west end of Hearthmere.
Touch the Anchor Stone by the Guild door, then tell Mira you are ready for Rhea's trial.

name: The Second One
journal: Haruto vanished in light when the goblins struck. Unbound Lightborn wake where they fell: at Mirror Lake, where the finders wait.

steps.text: Find Haruto at Mirror Lake before the finders sell him.

name: Clear the Slimes
journal: Slimes crowd the roads again. The Guild pays for every five cleared.

steps.text: Report to Mira at the Guild.

name: Goblin Bounty
journal: A bounty on goblins south of the village.

steps.text: Report to Mira at the Guild.

name: Gel for the Alchemist
journal: Wren needs slime gel for her potions.

name: Proof of the Hunt
journal: The Guild wants goblin teeth as proof of the hunt.
